from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, json, sys, tempfile

home=Path.home()
bridge=home/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
bus=home/'.local/share/prediction-command-bus'
sys.path.insert(0,str(bridge)); sys.path.insert(0,str(bus))

def load(name,path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[name]=mod; spec.loader.exec_module(mod); return mod

router=load('runtime_router_e005',bridge/'command_router.py')
assert getattr(router.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatCommandRouter/0.2'
poller=load('runtime_poller_e005',bus/'command_bus_poller.py')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    routes=Path(td)/'routes'; routes.mkdir()
    poller.ROUTES=routes
    task='SESSION-ROUTE-06b02c18b66873daa2c4548a'
    (routes/f'{task}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'task_id':task,'chat_id':'chat-e005-canonical','consumer_id':'tab-e005-canonical'}),encoding='utf-8')
    route,source=poller.resolve_route({'route_task_id':task})
    assert source==f'task:{task}'
    assert route=={'chat_id':'chat-e005-canonical','consumer_id':'tab-e005-canonical'}
wake=load('runtime_wake_e005',bridge/'bridge_server.py')
assert 'status-compaction' in getattr(wake.Handler,'server_version','')
print('CANONICAL_SESSION_ROUTING_E005=PASS')
print('ROUTER_VERSION='+router.Handler.server_version)
print('WAKE_VERSION='+wake.Handler.server_version)
